classes.intro: Expert marksmen with disciplined bow technique and practical crossbow mastery.

perks.name: Practiced Aim
perks.description: +7% bow and crossbow damage.

perks.name: Magic Shot
perks.description: 25% chance to not consume arrows or bolts.

perks.name: Combat Rhythm
perks.description: Bow hits grant Arrow Slinger for 6s, reducing draw time by 25%. Crossbow hits grant Quick Crank for 6s, reducing reload time by 25%.

perks.name: Storm Fletching
perks.description: Bow and crossbow attacks deal bonus lightning damage equal to 12% of weapon damage.

perks.name: Deadeye
perks.description: +15% bow and crossbow damage. Hits beyond 25m gain an additional +10% damage.

classes.outro: Best for players who want ranged weapons to feel steady early, distinct by weapon type mid-game, and deadly at mastery.

classes.intro: Stealthy fighters who use knives, positioning, and toxins to end fights quickly.

perks.name: Cutthroat
perks.description: +7% knife damage.

perks.name: Silent Hands
perks.description: Knife attacks and stealth movement consume 15% less stamina.

perks.name: Assassination
perks.description: First knife hit from stealth deals +50% damage. After a stealth hit, knife attack speed is increased by 20% for 5s.

perks.name: Venom Coating
perks.description: Knife hits apply stacking poison damage over time, up to 3 stacks. Poison damage scales with knife skill.

perks.name: Twist the Knife
perks.description: +15% knife damage against poisoned targets. Poisoned enemies deal 10% less damage to you.

classes.outro: Best for players who want the class to build from light knife mastery into stealth burst and poison execution.

classes.intro: Bare-knuckle fighters who turn momentum, toughness, and close-range pressure into damage.

perks.name: Bare-Knuckle Training
perks.description: +8% unarmed damage.

perks.name: Light on Your Feet
perks.description: Unarmed attacks consume 10% less stamina and jumping while unarmed consumes 10% less stamina.

perks.name: One-Two Combo
perks.description: Every 3rd consecutive unarmed hit deals +50% damage and restores 5% stamina. Combo resets after 4s without an unarmed hit.

perks.name: Iron Fist
perks.description: Unarmed attacks deal bonus spirit damage equal to 10% of weapon damage equivalent.

perks.name: Rage
perks.description: After taking unblocked damage, enter Rage for 5s: +20% unarmed damage and +20% attack speed. 20s cooldown.

classes.outro: Best for players who want fists to start modestly, become combo-driven, and finish with a clear mastery burst.

classes.intro: Defensive specialists who control combat through shields, blocks, and retaliatory force.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.description: +8% block power and -8% block stamina cost.

perks.name: Shield Bearer
perks.description: Shield impose no movement speed penalties.

perks.name: Perfect Guard
perks.description: Blocking within the first moment of an incoming hit restores 8 stamina and empowers your next attack or shield bash within 4s for +20% stagger.

perks.name: Thorns
perks.description: Blocked attacks return pierce damage equal to 20% of the original blocked damage.

perks.name: Reverb!
perks.description: After blocking 200 damage, release a 5m shockwave dealing 200 blunt damage and high stagger. 10s cooldown.

classes.outro: Best for players who want shield progression to feel defensive first, then increasingly forceful and reactive.

classes.intro: Heavy blunt weapon specialists who break armor, shake crowds, and turn slow weapons into decisive hits.

perks.name: Bonebreaker
perks.description: +8% blunt damage with clubs, maces, and two-handed hammers.

perks.name: Colossus
perks.description: Ignore movement speed penalties from blunt weapons and reduce blunt weapon equip weight by 50%.

perks.name: Thundering Blows
perks.description: One-handed mace heavy attacks create a 3m shockwave for 25% weapon damage. Two-handed hammer attacks create a 3m aftershock on direct enemy hits for 20% weapon damage.

perks.name: Cold Steel
perks.description: Blunt attacks deal bonus frost damage equal to 12% of weapon damage.

perks.name: Earthshaker
perks.description: +15% blunt damage. Staggering an enemy grants +10% attack speed with blunt weapons for 5s.

classes.outro: Best for players who want both maces and two-handed hammers to receive a meaningful version of each perk tier.

classes.intro: Spear and polearm specialists who win through reach, spacing, throws, and sweeping control.

perks.name: Reach Advantage
perks.description: +8% pierce damage with spears and polearms.

perks.name: Balanced Grip
perks.description: Thrown spears are easier to recover with a 20% larger pickup radius, and polearms impose no movement penalties.

perks.name: Spear Storm
perks.description: Spear hits build up to 5 stacks; each stack grants +3% attack speed for 5s. Polearm hits build up to 5 stacks; each stack grants +3% stagger damage for 5s.

perks.name: Stormpoint
perks.description: Spear and polearm attacks deal bonus lightning damage equal to 12% of weapon damage.

perks.name: Impaling Momentum
perks.description: +15% spear and polearm damage. Thrown spear hits beyond 15m and polearm special attacks gain an additional +10% damage.

classes.outro: Best for players who want spears and polearms to share a class identity while preserving their different combat rhythms.

classes.intro: Blade specialists who reward clean timing, fast footwork, and precise melee pressure.

perks.name: Blade Training
perks.description: +7% sword damage.

perks.name: Duelist's Balance
perks.description: Sword stamina costs are reduced by 10%, and swords impose no movement speed penalties.

perks.name: Riposte Training
perks.description: One-handed sword hits within 2s after a parry deal +30% damage. Greatsword special attacks within 2s after a parry deal +30% damage and +20% stagger.

perks.name: Searing Edge
perks.description: Sword attacks deal bonus fire damage equal to 12% of weapon damage.

perks.name: Dancing Steel
perks.description: +15% sword attack speed. Parrying grants an additional +10% sword damage for 5s.

classes.outro: Best for players who want swords and greatswords to feel precise, reactive, and rewarding without absorbing axe identity.

classes.intro: Elemental magic specialists who turn Eitr, spell momentum, and elemental affinities into sustained magical pressure.

perks.name: Eitr Weave
perks.description: +7% elemental magic damage.

perks.name: Arcane Nourishment
perks.description: Eitr granted by food is increased by 15%.

perks.name: Arcane Surge
perks.description: Dealing elemental magic damage grants +25% Eitr regeneration for 6s. Additional elemental magic damage refreshes the duration.

perks.name: Arcane Efficiency
perks.description: Elemental magic weapon Eitr costs are reduced by 10%.

perks.name: Archmage
perks.description: Dealing 500 damage of a single elemental affinity triggers its matching Archmage aura for 20s. Only one Archmage aura may be active at a time.

classes.outro: Best for players who want Elemental Magic to grow from efficient casting into sustained spell pressure and affinity-based Archmage auras.

classes.intro: Blood magic specialists who turn health sacrifice, forbidden summons, and recovered life into dangerous sustained power.

perks.name: Forbidden Knowledge
perks.description: +7% blood magic damage and summoned creature damage.

perks.name: Blood Feast
perks.description: Health granted by food and food-based health regeneration are increased by 15%.

perks.name: Blood Pact
perks.description: Sacrificing health with a blood magic weapon grants Blood Pact for 8s, increasing blood magic and summoned creature damage by 20%. Additional qualifying sacrifices refresh the duration.

perks.name: Dark Efficiency
perks.description: Blood magic weapon Eitr costs are reduced by 10%. Health sacrifice costs are unchanged.

perks.name: Sanguine Reclamation
perks.description: Health-sacrificing blood magic casts build Bloodwell charges. At 4 charges, gain Sanguine Reclamation for 20s: blood magic and summoned creature damage restores 5% of damage dealt as health, capped at 5 health per second.

classes.outro: Best for players who want Blood Magic to revolve around deliberate health sacrifice, empowered summons, and earning windows of aggressive life recovery.

classes.intro: Axe specialists who trade finesse for brutal chopping power, wounds, and relentless finishing pressure.

perks.name: Chopper's Training
perks.description: +8% axe damage with one-handed axes and battleaxes.

perks.name: Woodsman's Carry
perks.description: Axes weigh 50% less and impose no movement speed penalties.

perks.name: Rending Rhythm
perks.description: One-handed axe hits against the same target build up to 3 stacks; each stack grants +5% damage to that target for 5s. Battleaxe special attacks apply all 3 stacks at once.

perks.name: Hemorrhage
perks.description: Axe attacks apply bleed, dealing slash damage over time equal to 12% of weapon damage over 5s. Reapplying bleed refreshes the duration.

perks.name: Executioner
perks.description: +15% axe damage. Axe attacks deal an additional +10% damage against enemies below 40% health.

classes.outro: Best for players who enjoy heavy slashing attacks.
